newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to auction 2-yr,10-yr JGBs next week - sources.
newsitem.headline: Japan to auction 2-yr,10-yr JGBs next week - sources.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) will hold price-competitive auctions of two-year and 10-year Japanese government bonds (JGBs) next week, bond market sources said on Friday.
The coupon rate of the new 10-year JGB to be issued in April is likely to be set at a record low 2.5 percent, bond traders said.
"Institutional investors may refrain from placing bids at the auction because the timing is touchy," said a dealer at a bank's securities unit.

The 10-year JGB auction is likely to be held next Tuesday, while the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee is scheduled to meet later that day, and the Bank of Japan's "tankan" quarterly corporate survey follows soon after on April 2, he said.
When the MOF last auctioned 10-year bonds on February 25, it offered one trillion yen of 2.6 percent 10-year JGBs.
The two-year JGB auction is expected to be held in the latter half of the next week, bond traders said.
The MOF last auctioned two-year government notes on February 27, when it offered 120 billion yen in 0.6 percent JGBs.
